categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC parameter validation for createrawtransaction.
categories.rationale: Enforces strict type validation on the `data` parameter in `createrawtransaction` so that raw numbers are not coerced into hex. According to the PR description, the RPC currently accepts numeric JSON values like `99` as valid hex and converts them to byte `0x99`, which violates documented parameter types.
